# Breadcrumb

The path from the top to the current page.

- Status: implemented
- Category: navigation
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “breadcrumb”; HTML `<nav aria-label> with an ordered list`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **list**: Ordered list of links.
- **separator**: Drawn, out of the accessible name; turns with the reading direction.
- **current**: The last item, aria-current=page, not a link.

## Variants

- `default`: Full path; middle items fold on a phone.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Through the links. |

## Accessibility

- Role: navigation with a list
- Name: aria-label ("Breadcrumb", localized).

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.4.8 Location (AAA)

Web: `.nd-breadcrumb` in kit.css.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<nav class="nd-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
  <ol>
    <li><a href="#breadcrumb">Home</a></li>
    <li><a href="#breadcrumb">Section</a></li>
    <li><span aria-current="page">Current page</span></li>
  </ol>
</nav>
```
